name: Microphone stand
summary: Tall straight microphone stand with a round base and a mic clipped at the top; anim sway for singing scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the round base rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale; 1 m is about 560 px, so at s = 1 the stand is about 1.6 m (920 px) tall

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the mic head tilts gently on its clip
